answer: Under EigenTrust, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service rather than accumulated once. Reciprocity-weighted transitive trust propagates only from established, credible peers; a freshly spawned Sybil identity has negligible incoming support and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality, leaving it unable to meet consensus thresholds. A meadow of identities, ivory credentials, or copper tokens cannot substitute for that history.
